issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning double, but the solution implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int. This mismatch between the specification and the reference implementation can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to failing tests or incorrect implementations (e.g., loss of fractional students-per-tutor values).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent with the UML/specification. Either update the solution (and template method signature) to return double and implement it as: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); } or change the UML/specification to indicate an int return type if integer division is intended. Prefer returning double to preserve fractional values.
